messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: SRE P1 - increased 5xx and high token latency from az-west-2a inference pool (hosted). Targets: model-serving-g5a-az1a. 5xx ~12% over 5m, KVCACHE errors, SYN retransmit spikes. Paging @oncall-sre and @ryan.

oncall-sre: Paging in. I see p95 latency spike and a cluster of econnreset traces. Starting triage. @ryan can you confirm if this looks networky?

ryan: On it. Flow logs show NAT GW SNAT allocation failures and ~40% SYN drops from the g5 fleet in subnet az1a. Also a surge of ENI detach/failures around the same time. I'm collecting ENI attach/detach logs now.

priya: From the runtime side: model processes healthy, but proxy -> model handshakes are failing intermittently. KVCACHE miss rate jumped (regen storms). Token latency p95 >1.2s for some tenants.

sasha: Starting traffic steer: will canary to az-west-2b and reduce default batch sizes to reduce amplification. Pushing canary at 20% for affected routes.

oncall-sre: Good. Deploy a global batch-size reduction as a blunt mitigation. @deploy-bot please apply.

deploy-bot: @oncall-sre run commands queued: 
```
rcs set inference.batch_size=8 --scope=hosted --target=region:az-west-2 --change-id=chg-178500
rcs set inference.timeout_ms=90000 --target=hosted
```
Applying now.

netops-bot: AWS support notes: partial AZ egress path saturation and NIC firmware anomalies reported for a small subset of hosts. They're recommending steering to alternate NAT path and replacing affected instances. We've opened a ticket.

ryan: Executing route table overlay to prefer nat-gw-2 in az1b for inference subnets and deregistering unhealthy targets from NLB target-group. Command snippet: 
```
aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:...:tg/tsg --targets Id=i-0abcd1234
```
Deregistering hosts with repeated ENI detach.

priya: KVCACHE miss rate dropping after canary steer and batch shrink: 72% -> 30% in 7m. p95 latency improving 1200ms -> 650ms for canary traffic.

oncall-sre: Quick customer impact calc: ~8% of external inference requests observed 5xx/timeouts in last 10m clustered to az-west-2a. @cs-rep please prepare a short status.

cs-rep: Draft status: "We're investigating elevated errors for inference requests in az-west-2a. Traffic is being rerouted and mitigations are in progress. We'll provide another update in 30 minutes." Sharing for review.

sasha: Proposing fallback to smaller quantized model variant for traffic routed through fallback paths to reduce memory/latency pressure. This will be opt-in per-tenant. Thoughts?

ryan: Spin up extra replacement instances in az-west-2b and enable cross-region fallback to eu-west-1 for heavy tenants while AWS replaces impacted hosts. Starting instance allocations now.

priya: Running quick evals on quantized fallback. Early telemetry: no notable quality regressions for most tenants; latency improved on fallback path. Will keep monitoring.

deploy-bot: Canary shift progress: 20% -> 60% over 8m. No notable increase in 5xx on target region.

incident-bot: Pager update: 5xx rate stabilized to ~2.1% (down from 12%). p95 latency improved to ~420ms. Continued mitigation in progress.

sasha: Plan: keep traffic steer + deregister problematic instances. Quarantine hosts with repeated ENI detaches and scale replacement fleet. ETA for fleet replacement: ~25m.

ryan: AWS confirmed "network NIC firmware issue" affecting a hardware batch in az-west-2a; they've offered replacement host allocation and recommended customer-side steering as we replace. We're coordinating bulk drift of pods to healthy hosts.

oncall-sre: If we hold <1% 5xx for 30m, we'll move to recovery state. Handoff to daytime SRE in ~30m. If regressions reappear escalate to SEV.

cs-rep: Sending the updated status to affected customers now. Email + status page updated.

priya: Post-incident notes to collect: NAT SNAT exhaustion patterns, ENI detach waves, KVCACHE regen amplification, TTLs used for NLB health checks, and impact per-tenant. Collecting logs and eval pass/fail.

sasha: Adding a permanent runbook draft: "az-west-2a-nic-firmware-wave" with steps: drain hosts, route-steer, reduce batching, enable quantized fallback, register replacements, and customer comms template.

oncall-sre: Handoff to @ryan in 30m. Keep this channel updated with any regressions. Thanks all :thumbsup:

(deploy-bot automated note): change chg-178500 applied - batch_size updated.

(incident-bot automated summary queued for postmortem): root causes suspected: NIC firmware bug + NAT SNAT exhaustion -> ENI detach cascade -> kvcache regen -> latency/errors. Actions: route-steer, batch reduce, fallback enable, host replacement.
